package conformance

import (
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/hex"
 "encoding/json/v2"
 "os"
 "testing"
)
func TestProofFrozenV2(t *testing.T) {
 suite, err := NewSuite(t.Context(), SchemaV2, Reference{}.Declare()); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 files, err := suite.ExportFiles(t.Context()); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 raw, err := os.ReadFile("/tmp/s7-v2-export-sha256.json"); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 var hashes map[string]string; if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &hashes); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if len(hashes) != len(files) { t.Fatalf("count: %d != %d", len(hashes), len(files)) }
 for name, data := range files { sum := sha256.Sum256(data); if hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]) != hashes[name] { t.Errorf("changed v2: %s", name) } }
}
